reviews.body: Reviewed head 989937a3. The map is only ever appended to, so seq values are unique and stable. Ran go test -run Codex on ./internal/providers locally: pass. merge-tree against dev is clean. CI go/web/release-versioning are green. The new test streams 12 calls and would fail with random map order. No findings. Approving. (github-maintain automation)
